Two adults travelling from Helsinki on a low‑budget day‑trip to explore Tallinn’s Old Town and enjoy a nice lunch. Typical weather for mid‑May is overcast, 9‑18 °C. No overnight stay is needed.

## Getting there and back

**Outbound (Helsinki → Tallinn)**

| ✅ Chosen (cheapest) | Ferry | Viking Line | 10:13 → 13:25 | 3 h 12 min | 2 | €32.0 (web estimate) | [details](https://www.vikingline.com/find-your-trip/trips-for-individuals/) |
| 🚀 Fastest alternative | Flight | Finnair | 09:10 → 09:40 | 0 h 30 min | 0 | €164.0 (live) | [details](https://kiwi.com/u/8tg2kub2z8) |

**Return (Tallinn → Helsinki)**

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ✅ Chosen (cheapest) | Ferry | Tallink Grupp AS | 19:14 → 21:56 | 2 h 42 min | 2 | €73.8 (web estimate) | [details](https://en.tallink.com/book-a-cruise?voyageType=SHUTTLE) |
| 🚀 Fastest alternative | Flight | Finnair | 21:20 → 21:50 | 0 h 30 min | 0 | €144.0 (live) | [details](https://kiwi.com/u/z98u73t8sr) |

**Warnings**
- Ferry timetables are based on estimates beyond the published schedule; check exact times before booking.
- Flight options are significantly more expensive than the budget.

## Where to stay
No accommodation needed – this is a day‑trip returning the same evening.

## Day by day

*Days in this plan start around 09:30 and end by 22:00, at a balanced pace (the defaults). For another rhythm, tell the concierge, e.g. "we wake up early, start at 07:00", "we stay out late" or "a more relaxed pace, please".*

### Day 1 – Sat 2027-05-15: Tallinn Old Town
**Weather:** overcast, 9‑18 °C **Walking:** ~0.7 km

- **13:25 Arrive in Tallinn** – Ferry with Viking Line (see Getting there and back).
- **13:30 Lunch – Kohvik Energia** – Inexpensive cafeteria offering soups, sandwiches, salads and pastries (price €1‑10). Recommended low‑budget spot. [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Tallinn)
- **15:00 Town Hall Square** – Central UNESCO‑listed square surrounded by historic buildings; great for photos and atmosphere. [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Tallinn)
- **15:45 Town Hall** – 14‑15th‑century town hall museum (free entry). Open Mo‑Sa 10:00‑18:00; closed Sun. [ticket free] [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Tallinn)
- **17:00 Take tram to harbour** – Tram (≈5 min) from Old Town to Tallink harbour; arrive ~17:05.
- **19:14 Depart from Tallinn** – Ferry with Tallink Grupp AS (see Getting there and back).

## Food to try
- **verivorst** – Estonia's national pig's blood sausage, similar to black pudding, usually served with lingonberry jam. [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Estonia#Eat)
- **mulgikapsad** – Sauerkraut stew often served alongside verivorst. [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Estonia#Eat)
- **hapukoor** – 20 %‑fat sour cream used as a dressing for salads and other dishes. [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Estonia#Eat)
- **kartulisalat** – Estonian style potato salad, typically served with meat dishes. [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Estonia#Eat)
- **kohuke** – Chocolate‑covered curd snack, widely available in Estonian supermarkets. [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Estonia#Eat)
- **mustamakkara** – Finnish‑style black‑blood sausage, similar to verivorst, popular in winter. [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Estonia#Eat)

## Good to know
- Verify ferry departure/arrival times as the published schedule does not cover 2027‑05‑15.
- The day‑trip exceeds the €150 budget by €25.8; consider adjusting food or transport choices if strict adherence is required.
- No sights are closed on the planned day; all listed opening hours apply.
